Linear requirements and discussion can now travel with repository memory: import selected projects, retrieve cited issue evidence alongside code and sessions, start work with an issue-aware brief, and retain the outcome of user-requested Linear actions.

## What ships

- **Repository-scoped issue memory:** project descriptions, issues, and individual comments in immutable snapshots. Resumable imports cover active issues plus those completed/canceled in the last 90 days; explicitly referenced older issues remain fetchable.
- **Ordinary Brain retrieval:** lexical/hybrid search, semantic caching, exact-revision get/multi-get, and `brief --issue`. Results retain source URLs, freshness and completeness caveats; large records expand through snapshot-pinned continuation IDs.
- **A host-neutral workflow:** six CLI/MCP issue tools manage local evidence, work links, and operation receipts. The host's Linear MCP handles authentication and requested creates/comments/field updates; Brain receives no Linear credentials.

## Demonstrated end to end

Using **Unified, Pluggable Agent Memory**, imported the project and its issues, created sample [COR-1825](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/COR-1825/sample-brain-acceptance-offline-linear-evidence-round-trip), produced a cited brief, posted the authorized test comment, and retrieved the confirmed comment offline.

```sh
entire brain brief --issue COR-1825 --json
entire brain query "brain-linear-comment-20260917-4f1be802" --source issue --json
```

The local MCP round trip verified batch replay, default-query recall, pinned briefs, exact snapshot reads, and successful operation receipts with no-egress enabled.

## Verification

- Storage and affected CLI/MCP, retrieval, brief, workspace, and documentation tests pass.
- Regression tests cover purge during ranking/output, incomplete-to-full refreshes, comments moving with issues, split-batch completion, and paginated Unicode evidence across concurrent refreshes.
- Windows arm64, Linux amd64, and macOS arm64 builds pass. Linux/macOS runtime tests were not run here; 37 full-suite Windows failures were independently reproduced on unchanged mainline.
- Existing bundle/publish paths exclude issue content.

[Workflow and contracts](https://github.com/entireio/entire-brain/blob/dc30aff132b58d95f852b3b2ebbb163e271beee3/docs/linear-workflow.md) · [Verification details](https://github.com/entireio/entire-brain/blob/dc30aff132b58d95f852b3b2ebbb163e271beee3/docs/linear-verification.md)

## Direction

The provider-neutral issue layer is a foundation for other trackers and a continuous requirements → implementation → evidence loop. Future work could add opt-in durable-fact extraction, incremental synchronization, and shared team memory. This release stays local and on demand; background sync, native OAuth, and hosted issue storage are deferred.

## Entire provenance

[Checkpoint `a332fa8ca8a6`](https://github.com/entireio/entire-brain/tree/2d1ae0e96416d0bfcb3491d761edeac586aa132c/a3/32fa8ca8a6) is linked from the final commit and preserves all three related sessions: planning, the separate review, and implementation/live acceptance/review fixes.
